summary: Enable Prompt on Launch in AAP job or workflow templates so Terraform can override settings at runtime, reusing one template across many .tf files and environments. Supported fields: inventory and extra variables (JSON or YAML string). If a prompted value is not set in the .tf file, the run fails with an error.
questions: How can Terraform override inventory or extra vars on an AAP job template?
Can one AAP job template serve many Terraform environments?
What happens if Terraform does not supply a prompted value?
Which Prompt on Launch fields does the Terraform provider support?
